Data:Hatch.egg.gull.fireplace.json.label: Hatch the Egg
Data:Hatch.egg.gull.fireplace.json.startdescription: The fire's warmth can stir this egg to life - but it'll take a full day.

Data:Hatch.egg.gull.kitchen.json.label: Hatch the Egg
Data:Hatch.egg.gull.kitchen.json.startdescription: The oven's warmth can stir this egg to life - but it'll take a full day.

Data:Hawthorn.blank.json.Label: Hawthorn Blank
Data:Hawthorn.blank.json.Desc: A wood favoured by the Horned-Axe.

Data:Healing.herbs.json.Label: Healing Herbs
Data:Healing.herbs.json.Desc: A helpful harvest of healing herbs.

Data:Heart.json.label: Heart
Data:Heart.json.desc: The Heart Relentless beats to protect the skin of the world we understand. [The Heart is the principle that continues and preserves.]

Data:Heart.only.hint.json.label: Now What?
Data:Heart.only.hint.json.startdescription: There's potential here. [Start by adding a Soul card.]

Data:Hint.essential.json.label: ESSENTIAL
Data:Hint.essential.json.desc: To go in this slot, an object must match at least one of these.

Data:Hint.forbidden.json.label: FORBIDDEN
Data:Hint.forbidden.json.desc: If an object matches any of these, it can't go in this slot.

Data:Hint.recruit.12.json.label: A Reasonable Price?
Data:Hint.recruit.12.json.startdescription: One shilling - twelve pence - will hire this one's services.

Data:Hint.recruit.12.rectory.json.label: A Fair Arrangement?
Data:Hint.recruit.12.rectory.json.startdescription: 'I suppose I could spare a few hours, if you can spare, let us say, a shilling for the church roof fund?'

Data:Hint.recruit.12.sweetbones.json.label: A Fair Arrangement?
Data:Hint.recruit.12.sweetbones.json.startdescription: One shilling - twelve pence - will hire a casual labourer's services.

Data:Hint.recruit.24.json.label: A Fair Price?
Data:Hint.recruit.24.json.startdescription: Two shillings - twenty-four pence - will hire this one's services.

Data:Hint.required.json.label: REQUIRED
Data:Hint.required.json.desc: To go in this slot, an object must match at least one of these.

Data:Hint.tothethresholdofthehouse.json.label: TO THE THRESHOLD OF THE HOUSE
Data:Hint.tothethresholdofthehouse.json.desc: [You can only keep five things in your belongings. A sixth item will be abandoned unless it already has a home. Abandoned items will wait for you outside the House.]

Data:Hint.workstation.json.label: Workstation Hints
Data:Hint.workstation.json.desc:
Aspects most likely to be useful here: 

[further]

Data:History.json.label: History
Data:History.json.desc: History is not what happened; it's what is known to have happened. [You have made a decision that will change the world's course. Bring your journal to the Tree in the season of Numa.]

Data:Hokobald.json.label: Magister Hokobald
Data:Hokobald.json.desc: Metallurgist, gourmet, corrupted immortal. And, supposedly, a long-ago king's by-blow.

Data:Hokobald.likes.douglas.json.desc: Hokobald has develped a condescending sort of liking for Douglas.

Data:Holiest.hemolymph.json.Label: Holiest Hemolymph
Data:Holiest.hemolymph.json.Desc: Thirza Blake claimed that she first synthesised this from her own tears. She was almost certainly lying.

Data:Honey.cuckoo.json.Label: Cuckoo-Honey
Data:Honey.cuckoo.json.Desc: The Blomberende were rogues and trickster-heroes among the Carapace-kinds: ingenious, brave, prolific, untrustworthy. In Numa, their children might yet bring their gifts to ordinary hives…

xexts.scrutiny: A fleetingly familiar taste, and a prickling in the skull…  not surprising, perhaps, that it can be brewed into Skinshuck Mead with the great arts of Moth.

Data:Honey.json.Label: Honey
Data:Honey.json.Desc: The blood of the Hour called Malachite; also and furthermore, wonderful on toast.

xexts.scrutiny: The source, among other things, of Skinshuck Mead, when brewed with the great arts of Moth…

Ambrose Westcott found a way to scent his pipe tobacco with honeyscar. Kitty Mazarine made jam. And Gervinus van Lauren, it is said, found a Keeper-level recipe which somehow uses it as the basis for the azoth...

Data:Horizonsight.json.Label: Horizon-Sight
Data:Horizonsight.json.Desc: 'On a clear autumn day, the story goes, you can see Ys from the Watchman's Tower. I don't know whether that's true. But on a clear day in Numa… you would see the City Unbuilt.' - Dr Brian Levinsen

Data:Host.technique.summon.echidna.json.label: Host Echidna Technique
Data:Host.technique.summon.echidna.json.desc: This skill can host the Summon Echidna Technique

Data:Houndsgall.json.Label: Houndsgall
Data:Houndsgall.json.Desc: Books written in Houndsgall are more likely to return to their owner, or one to whom they have been legitimately sold. An Ink of Containment.

xexts.scrutiny: It'll be hell to get off my fingers. [There are Keeper-level Scale recipes that can produce this with the tacit assistance of a Living Relic.]

Data:Hourglass.scale.g.json.Label: Serpent-Styled Glass
Data:Hourglass.scale.g.json.Desc: Carved snakes writhe up the frame. A prominent inscription reads TO THE LIBRARIAN WILLEM IN EARNEST OF OUR WAGER.

xexts.scrutiny: The inscription is repeated on the base of the sand-glass, in Sanskrit. And, indeed, the style is Eastern - though, I think, somewhere farther than India.

Data:Hourglass.scale.w.json.Label: Serpent-Styled Glass
Data:Hourglass.scale.w.json.Desc: Carved snakes writhe down the frame. A prominent inscription reads TO THE LIBRARIAN GERVINUS IN EARNEST OF OUR WAGER.

xexts.scrutiny: The inscription is repeated on the base of the sand-glass, in Sanskrit. And, indeed, the style is Eastern - though, I think, somewhere farther than India.

Data:Hours.sister.json.Label: 'The Sister-and-Witch'
Data:Hours.sister.json.Desc: 'The Sister-and-Witch brings together what cannot be apart. She is sought beneath the moon and at the water's edge. She is pearl, amber, coral; she cannot be touched; she cannot be separated.'

xexts.scrutiny: Abbot Geffrey recorded a prophetic dream: two women, one in violet, one in white, gathering seashells. The white-clad one, he wrote, handed him a shell and reminded him that one cannot keep what one cannot hold…

Data:Hours.thunderskin.json.Label: 'The Thunderskin'
Data:Hours.thunderskin.json.Desc: 'He cannot be stilled; he demands the dance; he is beaten, like a drum. He is heard in the Wood below the world.'

xexts.scrutiny: A story is told of Hendrik, 1st Baron Dewulf, and a local cunning man, one Red William, who placed a curse on the Dewulfs: 'There will be no seventh of their line.' There is another story that it was no curse but a prophecy, and that Hendrik did not execute William but kept him safe in the caves below the isle...

Data:Hours.velvet.json.Label: 'The Velvet'
Data:Hours.velvet.json.Desc: 'The Glory is a question, and the Moth always answers Yes. The Velvet's answer is No, and that is always her answer.'

xexts.scrutiny: The Velvet is the Hour that keeps secrets, and this painting has no more secrets to share.

Data:Hours.witch.json.Label: 'The Witch-and-Sister'
Data:Hours.witch.json.Desc: 'The Witch-and-Sister unites what is at rest. She is sought at the water's edge and beneath the moon. She cannot be separated; she cannot be touched; she is coral, amber, pearl'

xexts.scrutiny: Abbot Geffrey recorded a prophetic dream: two women, one in violet, one in white, gathering seashells. Each gave him a shell, but each gave him different advice…

Data:Houseoflight.menu.food.json.label: FOOD
Data:Houseoflight.menu.food.json.desc:
Combine ingredients at the three Kitchen workstations to create dozens of new dishes. You'll need Kitchenware items to find all the recipes. 
TIP: The Spice Scales, and the Spices & Savours skill, will substitute for each other.

Data:Houseoflight.menu.furtherstories.js.label: FURTHER STORIES
Data:Houseoflight.menu.furtherstories.js.desc: Once you've completed an Incident, follow it up in the Tree of Wisdoms. Visitors will need more specific help here - perhaps a book on a specific topic, or a specific book. TIP: An Affair opens to Further Stories once all interested Visitors have had the opportunity to ask you for help with it. Be aware in some Further Stories, it can make a difference who you originally helped. Be careful. This is the one part of the game where choices can sometimes have permanent consequences.

Data:Houseoflight.menu.institute.json.label: THE INSTITUTE
Data:Houseoflight.menu.institute.json.desc:
Look for the lighthouse, out at sea. When your Visitors are ready, use it to establish the true heirs to the Curia of the Isle. 
TIP: Further Stories outcomes can inspire your Visitors to support the Institute - for their own reasons. Their nature is constant, but some story outcomes can make them decide to emphasise one agenda over another.

Data:Houseoflight.menu.intro.json.label: IN THE HOUSE OF LIGHT
Data:Houseoflight.menu.intro.json.desc: HOUSE OF LIGHT is a big expansion, woven deep into the game. Here's a spoiler-light guide on how to find to the new bits. NOTE: HOUSE OF LIGHT is compatible with existing saves, though once HOUSE OF LIGHT has touched a save, that save won't work if you remove the DLC.

Data:Houseoflight.menu.manuscripts.json.label: MANUSCRIPTS
Data:Houseoflight.menu.manuscripts.json.desc: Use Paper, Ink, and a Skill to write a Manuscript based on that skill. These Manuscripts may be necessary to satisfy thirsts for specific knowledge in FURTHER STORIES. Lessons from Salons will help you improve those Skills and write more useful Manuscripts. TIP: You can't reliably control what Visitors will discuss - it's a party, not an interrogation - but they'll usually provide lessons related to their shared Interests. NOTE: Perinculate cannot be used to write Manuscripts. It would be rude to write a manuscript that might kill visitors. (And Hokobald is probably immune anyway.)
